courseTitle: Crime and Punishment Through Time — Roman Courts to Modern Forensics (AD 43–Present)
disclaimer: The History Revision Hub — Key Stage 2 Primary History Mind Map.

root.label: Crime & Punishment
root.gloss: Two thousand years of British justice — from Roman Bath curse tablets, Anglo-Saxon wergild, and 1215 Magna Carta to Guy Fawkes, the Bloody Code, Elizabeth Fry, 1829 Bobbies, and 1984 DNA forensics.
